caseName: Aberdeen & Rockfish Railroad v. Students Challenging Regulatory Agency Procedures
caseNameFull: Aberdeen & Rockfish Railroad Co. v. Students Challenging Regulatory Agency Procedures (SCRAP) and United States v. Students Challenging Regulatory Agency Procedures (SCRAP)

opinions.text:
Appeals from D. C. D. C. Judgment vacated and cases remanded for further consideration in light of Atchison, Topeka & Santa Fe R. Co. v. Wichita Board of Trade, 412 U. S. 800 (1973).

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these appeals.
